dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Evaluated without mitigations, we continue to not rule out Muse Spark 1.3 meeting this threshold in the Chemical & Biological domain.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: CB threshold determination; scores on MBCT, VCT, ABC Bench etc. (2.1)

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Muse Spark 1.3 finishes 3 of the 10 scenarios (30.0% pass@20 and 2.0% pass@1 across 20 attempts per scenario, each with a budget of 1000 shell commands)
dc_eval_cyber.note: cyber results; also CyberGym, ExploitGym, 'moderate or lower' determination

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: We assess Muse Spark 1.3 as “moderate or lower” for acceleration of AI development.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D acceleration evaluated as a risk with PostTrainBench/ResearchTasteBench/OptimBench results

dc_eval_persuasion.note: social-engineering evaluation is part of cyber (Cyber 3) per boundary rule; Petri Bloom 'emotional bond'/'flattery' are sycophancy-type behaviours not framed as persuasion or manipulation risk; 'manipulate' elsewhere refers to prompt injection

dc_eval_scheming.quote: We find suggestive evidence of strategic underperformance on Chemical & Biological evaluations.
dc_eval_scheming.note: sandbagging, SHADE-Arena stealth, evaluation awareness, Agentic Misalignment results

framework_threshold.quote: Our updated suite of cybersecurity evaluations supports a “moderate or lower” assessment for the unmitigated model in the Cybersecurity domain.
framework_threshold.note: places model against 'high risk' threshold of Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework

ext_test_any.quote: The Handshake AI red team conducted red teaming before the public launch of Muse.
ext_test_any.note: outside red team tested this model (also Scale AI, Gray Swan, Exponential Security Labs, Irregular)

ext_test_named_org.quote: We have shared pre-release access to Muse with Handshake AI’s red team for conducting human red teaming to find jailbreaks.
ext_test_named_org.note: named outside organisation; jailbreak red teaming is safety testing

ext_test_government.note: 'US AISI and UK AISI, 2024' is cited only as methodology from a test of another model (OpenAI o1); no government testing of this model

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: Before the release, we also conducted third-party red teaming on both Muse Spark 1.3 (API) and Muse Spark 1.3 (Muse) to validate these conclusions.

safeguards_training.quote: the ASR on JEF-Bench has greatly decreased from Muse Spark 1.1 to Muse Spark 1.3 (API) due to our training on mitigating agentic jailbreaks

safeguards_runtime.quote: In the launch context of Muse, we also integrate with additional layers for automated reviews and integrity monitoring to mitigate the misuse risk
safeguards_runtime.note: named runtime review and monitoring; also system-level CB/cyber mitigations

safeguards_access.note: no safety-tied access restriction (trusted access, KYC, tiers) described; account authorization is a product feature

safeguards_weights.quote: Meta’s model weight security strategy is built on a multi-pronged, lifecycle-driven framework designed to identify, assess, and mitigate systemic risks of tampering and theft. Our approach continues to incorporate the same pillars
safeguards_weights.note: weight security stated as continuing for this model
